name: Culture Amp
summary: Employee-experience platform (engagement surveys, performance, 1-on-1s). For agents: a first-party MCP connection lets Claude or ChatGPT read engagement survey results and trends, retrieve performance feedback, and read/write 1-on-1 agendas, under the user's own Culture Amp sign-in. There is no public fixed endpoint; an administrator turns the connection on and gives each user a per-account connection address, so it cannot be probed keyless. The connection excludes open-text survey comments.

payments.notes: cultureamp.com/platform/plans-and-pricing (200, 2026-11-15) carries no currency figure and routes to Book a demo / Contact sales; quote-based. The MCP requires an existing Culture Amp subscription and names no separate charge. Not machine-payable.

agentAccess.notes: No public fixed MCP endpoint: an administrator turns the connection on and gives each user a per-account connection address (support article 17605430, read 2026-11-15), so no keyless probe is possible. Sign-in is the user's own Culture Amp credentials, Google Workspace, or self-service SSO.
